verdict.rationale: pnpm supports bulk/workspace-wide operations via filtering ("run tasks on just the projects you touched"), catalogs for single-point dependency version updates across a monorepo, and audit --fix for bulk vulnerability remediation, and community reports confirm monorepo-wide task running works well in practice (pnpm-docs-6, pnpm-docs-7, pnpm-docs-36/40, pnpm-comm-12). However, none of this is framed for AI-native/agentic use—there's no machine-readable batch API, no scripting/automation interface tailored to AI agents, and no evidence of programmatic bulk control beyond standard CLI filtering. Missing for 10: agent-oriented batch/programmatic API, structured (JSON) output for bulk operations, explicit AI-agent workflow documentation.
